caption: The drawing depicts a single transparent glass pitcher placed centrally on a plain beige background. The pitcher has a bulbous ribbed lower body and a narrower neck that flares outward near the opening. The rim of the pitcher is outlined in blue, providing a stark contrast to the otherwise clear glass material. The handle, attached to the right side, is curved with a distinct, decorative scroll at the bottom. The transparency of the glass is highlighted by gray shadows and white reflective highlights, giving a sense of dimensionality and realism. There is no additional decoration or objects present in the drawing aside from the pitcher itself.
title: Small Pitcher
